title_ar: نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
title_en: Supporting the Prophet (Peace and Blessings Be upon Him)
body_ar:
-مكانة النبي (ص) ووجوب نصرته. - مفهوم النصرة وسبل تحقيقها. - دور ولات الأمور في نصرة النبي (ص). - المقاطعة جدواها وحكمها:
عبد الصمد ناصر: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وأهلا بكم إلى حلقة أخرى من برنامج الشريعة والحياة، يقول الله سبحانه وتعالى في محكم كتابه {يَا أَيُّهَا الَذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ ولِلرَّسُولِ إذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ} صدق الله العظيم، على خلفية الإساءة للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم تنادى العلماء والدعاة في العلم الإسلامي وممثلو المنظمات الإسلامية في الغرب لعقد المؤتمرات وبحث السبل العملية لنصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وانطلقت الجهود في التعريف بشخصه ورسالته فكيف تكون الاستجابة والنصرة في الوقت أو في الواقع المعاصر وما هي وسائلها العملية وما هو دور ولاة الأمور في تحقيق النصرة وكيف كان هدي النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في التعامل مع الآخرين من خصومه؟
body_en:
— The standing of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and the obligation (wujūb) to support him. — The concept of supporting him and the ways of realising it. — The role of those in authority in supporting the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him). — The boycott: its usefulness and its ruling:

Abd al-Samad Nasir: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God. Welcome to another episode of the programme Sharia and Life. God, Glorified and Exalted, says in the firm text of His Book: {O you who believe, respond to God and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life} — God the Almighty has spoken the truth. Against the background of the insult to the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him), scholars and preachers in the Islamic world, and representatives of Islamic organisations in the West, have called upon one another to hold conferences and to examine the practical ways of supporting the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him); and efforts have been set in motion to make his person and his message known. So how are response and support to be given in our time, or in contemporary reality, and what are their practical means, and what is the role of those in authority in realising that support, and what was the guidance of the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) in dealing with others among his adversaries?

flags.context: The page is filed under the Sheikh's written da'wah material but contains only the host's introduction to a television episode.
options: Suppress from publication and offer only the download
Publish with a prominent banner stating that the page contains no answer from the Sheikh
flags.note: Critical for display. The page poses four questions — including the ruling on boycott — and gives no answer at all, because the Sheikh's replies are only in the downloadable document. A reader arriving here would find the questions framed and might take the framing itself for the Sheikh's position. It must not be rendered as an article or a fatwa.

Severing relations: its usefulness and its ruling
flags.note: In the context of the cartoons controversy المقاطعة is the consumer/diplomatic boycott, and that reading is taken here. Note that the topic line announces a ruling (ḥukm) that the page never delivers.

flags.context: تنادى العلماء والدعاة في العلم الإسلامي وممثلو المنظمات الإسلامية في الغرب
options: in Islamic scholarship (reading العلم as the source has it)
flags.note: The source reads العلم الإسلامي where the sense plainly requires العالم الإسلامي ('the Islamic world'), especially given the contrast with 'in the West' that follows. Translated by sense and flagged rather than silently corrected in the Arabic.

translator_notes: Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.

The published page carries only the episode's topic list and the presenter's opening framing of a television discussion; the full transcript is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.
Not one word on this page is the Sheikh's. Everything after the topic list is spoken by the programme's host, Abd al-Samad Nasir, and consists of the questions he puts at the start of the episode.
